# tests/fixtures — shared synthetic test data (Owner: Member D, WBS 1.2.2)

Everyone develops against these files so nobody waits for upstream work. **All data here is synthetic**
(generated by `make_fixtures.py` with seed 42). It is not model output and must never be reported as a result.

| File | Contract | Used by |
|---|---|---|
| `sample_detections.jsonl` | C4 (600 frames, 2 min @ 5 fps, deliberate flicker) | C 4.1.x, 4.2.1 fixture mode |
| `sample_timeline.json` | C5 (case 01) | C 4.2.x, 4.3.1 · D web mock mode · A analytics |
| `sample_timeline_case02.json` | C5 (case 02) | C search/analytics tests · A analytics |
| `sample_notes.json` | Note objects (C6) | C 4.3.1 PDF golden test · D notes panel |
| `sample_presence.csv` | C3 | C 4.1.3 evaluate.py unit tests |
| `sample_video.mp4` | — | **TODO (D, 1.2.2)**: ≤10 MB, 2 min, synthetic or a licence-permitted public clip. Used by B's inference test. |

Regenerate: `python tests/fixtures/make_fixtures.py` (then run `pytest tests/contracts`).
